mapper.update: UPDATE meeting_confirmation SET task_version = #{taskVersion}, owner_user_id = #{ownerUserId}, owner_subject = #{ownerSubject}, status = #{status}, confirm_comment = NULL, card_message_id = NULL, last_event_id = NULL, card_status = #{cardStatus}, card_title = #{cardTitle}, card_description = #{cardDescription}, card_command_id = #{cardCommandId}, card_attempt_count = 0, card_next_attempt_at = #{now}, card_claim_token = NULL, card_lease_until = NULL, card_last_error = NULL, revision = revision + 1, updated_at = #{now} WHERE enterprise_id = #{enterpriseId} AND binding_id = #{bindingId} AND business_key = #{businessKey}
mapper.select: SELECT o.* FROM meeting_sync_outbox o JOIN meeting_binding b ON b.enterprise_id = o.enterprise_id AND b.id = o.binding_id AND b.business_type = 'task' LEFT JOIN meeting_confirmation c ON c.enterprise_id = o.enterprise_id AND c.binding_id = o.binding_id AND c.business_key = o.business_key WHERE o.delivered_version > 0 AND (c.id IS NULL OR c.task_version < o.delivered_version) ORDER BY o.updated_at ASC LIMIT #{limit}
